name: verificate
description: Merge gate for AI-written code, plans and documents: deterministic veto checks and a Claude Haiku 5.5 review, with one decision and a receipt per verdict.

interface.shortDescription: Review AI-written code before you ship it
interface.longDescription: Verificate Gate reviews AI-written code, plans and documents. Deterministic checks run first and can veto: placeholder or mock implementations, tests that cannot fail, Python standard-library calls that do not exist, secrets written to logs and unsupported completion claims. A Claude Haiku 5.5 review then checks the rest against ISO/IEC 25010 and ISO/IEC 5055, including whether third-party API calls are real. Each result has one decision (approved, approved with conditions, rejected or incomplete), findings with severities and a receipt. Submitted content is read, never executed. 100 free validations, no signup.
defaultPrompt: Validate this change with Verificate before we merge it
Review this implementation plan with Verificate
